 State Minimum Wage to Increase January 1 
 Ben Dylla 
 Ben Dylla 
 Author email 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Updated 
 8 hrs ago

 {KXLG - Pierre, SD} The state minimum wage for non-tipped employees will increase from $11.85/hour to $12.30/hour effective January 1, 2027.
 The minimum wage is adjusted annually based on increases in the cost of living, as measured by the Consumer Price Index published by the U.S. Department of Labor.
 South Dakota adjusts its minimum wage annually as established by SDCL 60-11-3.2 , a law enacted by the state legislature and effective since January 1, 2016.
 The hourly minimum wage for tipped employees will be $6.15/hour, effective January 1, 2027, half the minimum wage for non-tipped employees. Wages and tips combined must equal at least the minimum wage.
 These increases will apply to all South Dakota employers, with some limited exceptions. For more information, visit dlr.sd.gov/employment_laws/minimum_wage.aspx .
